LESSON: WEAVING CRAFT

Grade: PP2
Subject: PSYCHOMOTOR AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
Strand: PAPER
Topic 5.1: Weaving CRAFT

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Weaving CRAFT. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: What do we use to make a twine CRAFT learner should be able to; weaving weave?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. explain what Weaving CRAFT means in simple pupil language
2. give 3 correct examples of Weaving CRAFT from Kenya
3. practise Weaving CRAFT in clear steps
4. apply Weaving CRAFT in one real-life situation this week

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: WEAVING CRAFT
Subject: PSYCHOMOTOR AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES · Grade: PP2
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Weaving CRAFT helps you succeed in PSYCHOMOTOR AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: WEAVING CRAFT
Study Weaving CRAFT like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Explain what Weaving CRAFT means in simple pupil language

What this means
In this part you learn to explain what Weaving CRAFT means in simple pupil language. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: explain what Weaving CRAFT means in simple pupil language.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Weaving CRAFT” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can explain what Weaving CRAFT means in simple pupil language. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Give 3 correct examples of Weaving CRAFT from Kenya

What this means
In this part you learn to give 3 correct examples of Weaving CRAFT from Kenya. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: give 3 correct examples of Weaving CRAFT from Kenya.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Story link: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Weaving CRAFT in your own words.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can give 3 correct examples of Weaving CRAFT from Kenya. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 3: Practise Weaving CRAFT in clear steps

What this means
In this part you learn to practise Weaving CRAFT in clear steps. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: practise Weaving CRAFT in clear steps.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Daily habit: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can practise Weaving CRAFT in clear steps. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 4: Apply Weaving CRAFT in one real-life situation this week

What this means
In this part you learn to apply Weaving CRAFT in one real-life situation this week. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: apply Weaving CRAFT in one real-life situation this week.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Weaving CRAFT” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can apply Weaving CRAFT in one real-life situation this week. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Weaving CRAFT is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Weaving CRAFT” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: explain what Weaving CRAFT means in simple pupil language)

Example 2: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Weaving CRAFT in your own words. (skill: give 3 correct examples of Weaving CRAFT from Kenya)

Example 3: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson. (skill: practise Weaving CRAFT in clear steps)

Example 4: Show how “Weaving CRAFT” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: apply Weaving CRAFT in one real-life situation this week)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Weaving CRAFT to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: explain what Weaving CRAFT means in simple pupil language.
3. Practise this skill: give 3 correct examples of Weaving CRAFT from Kenya.
4. Practise this skill: practise Weaving CRAFT in clear steps.
5. Make one local Kenya example of Weaving CRAFT from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Weaving CRAFT: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a PP2 learner study Weaving CRAFT?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What do we use to make a twine CRAFT learner should be able to; weaving weave?
2. What are some of the tools used in weaving observe photographs of weaving?
3. Where can weave articles be used?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Weaving CRAFT means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: explain what Weaving CRAFT means in simple pupil language.
5. Be able to: give 3 correct examples of Weaving CRAFT from Kenya.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
